topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and framing cancer development as an evolutionary process influenced by mutations, cell types, and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cells acquire competitive growth advantages and cancer hallmarks through sequential driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue hierarchies, stemness, and the specific cell of origin govern cancer initiation and cellular heterogeneity.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Tumor Stroma, and Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments promote cancer development across disease stages and coevolve with mutating cells.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
